description: The Server 8.0 metafun.md has lost three of the four availability badges its Capella twin carries: Capella heads EVALUATE() with 'Couchbase Server 8.0', HASHBYTES() with 'Couchbase Server 8.0' and FINDERR() with 'Couchbase Server 7.6.5'; the Server page retains a badge only on EXTRACTDDL(). All four functions appear on both pages, so three availability facts are recoverable only from the Capella page. Keeping EXTRACTDDL's badge while dropping EVALUATE's and HASHBYTES's - all three being 8.0 features - reads as an editing oversight rather than policy, because the treatment within one page is inconsistent.
